question: Replicate cross-model observable prediction on64 fresh sources with frozen old-FIT probes.
evidence_class: Fresh-seed frozen-probe predictive replication; added-hidden follow-up is exploratory; no cross-model causal or semantic identity claim.

design.status: Frozen before native inference; slot2 granted by user after pilot review.
design.discovery: Synthetic sources from original pilot and replication FIT only;20 source groups,96 rows. Original selected kernels/alphas frozen from pilot selections.json. Coefficients and training support serialized; no pilot TEST target used in fitting or extension selection.
design.exploratory: input+Aforecast+Ahidden fixes original input+Aforecast feature choice, then selects added hidden rank8/16 and alpha on oldFIT source folds only. This arm was not a pilot primary. Fresh TEST cannot tune any arm.
design.preprocessing: Exactly the frozen pilot weighted centering, global hidden scale and dual PCA; input includes full history ridge, descriptor ridge, PCA and RBF selection. Targets and inverse use identical history mean/SD in every arm.

capture.normalization: Original native baseline; fusion leaves/zero use original full-context native normalizer and matching inverse.
capture.fusion: First block; depth1; equal leaf weights; affine zero correction; pure blend1. No random edits, deeper trees, stability sweeps, or other native endpoints. Tree abstention yields exact native forecast.

design.gates: Exact repeat, full-context locked-normalizer identity, first-block self patch and half-depth self patch on every row; input leaf closure <=2e-6 relative max(1,maxabs(history)). Native cuts/shapes/checkpoint hashes must match.
design.uncertainty: 64 seed groups,5 dependent conditions each. Equal source means and4000 paired source bootstrap draws. Primary3 gain-over-input intervals98.33333333333333%;95% descriptive intervals otherwise. No tuning/selection on fresh TEST.
design.source_null: 99 fixed evaluation-source permutations (seed4952100+j), matching each of five conditions within whole seed bundles. Frozen probes and input/Aforecast stay fixed; only Ahidden is source-shuffled. Report alignment tail rank as diagnostic, not conditional-independence or confirmatory p-value. TEST sources never enter training.
design.success: Each primary: >=5% loss reduction vs frozen strong input, Bonferroni3 interval lower>0, gain above95th percentile of99 alignment-shuffle gains. Report input+Aforecast comparison and same-model comparator regardless of success. Extra hidden beyond input+Aforecast is exploratory and cannot rescue failed primary.
design.behavior_vs_semantics: Response target is B fusion-minus-native, not known component semantics. Separately report native/fused error against true future, response energy, zero-response floor and tree eligibility. Predicting a model response or failure does not establish that response is correct or semantically shared.
